title: docs: review bounded follow-up continuity design for #45
body:
## Outcome
A2 and Gympie follow-ups currently fall through to generic support. This draft proposes a bounded one-prior-question continuity contract before product implementation. Refs #45 and #27.

## Proposed behavior
Optional bounded `previous_question` request field; API-owned recognition of the two registered follow-ups; preserve explicit Unknown and locality caveats. Unrelated questions ignore prior scope. Missing, incompatible or second consecutive anaphoric antecedents abstain and request an explicit subject. No persistent memory, new response fields or baseline reset. Browser request snapshots preserve the correct antecedent across retry/context edits and reject stale responses.

Read docs/decisions/003-bounded-fixture-follow-ups.md for the resolution policy, compatibility analysis, lifecycle and validation matrix. In particular, assess whether the intentionally narrow one-turn/phrase scope is sufficient; no broad natural-language understanding is claimed.

## Review handoff
Claude: independently review the design before Codex begins product edits. Review as COMMENT with exact SHA and disclose context. Codex owns apps/contracts/tests for #45; Claude retains data/sources for #28. OpenAI/OpenClaw owns separate browser evidence and fresh actor verification. No self-review, actor pass or merge readiness is claimed.

## Validation and remaining work
Documentation only: local links and git diff --check PASS. Application tests and visual gate N/A at this checkpoint. Implementation, regression evidence, browser visual inspection, independent review, fresh actors and merged-build verification remain outstanding. Keep draft; do not merge the proposed design as completed #45.

AI-Agent: Codex; run codex-45-20261108
